name: web_citation_fetch_provenance
description: oss-cite-01: widen source_citation_registry.citation_type to include 'web' (constraint re-derived from tools/provenance/registry.py::CITATION_TYPES, never hand-written), and create the append-only web_fetch_provenance table recording requested URL, final URL after redirects, redirect chain, HTTP status, fetched_at, content hash and ETag/Last-Modified.
